I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't check the 16 August deadline against anything. I found no Tamsin Cold Chain files in the share I can see, and #central-team doesn't mention it.

I only looked at #central-team and the shared files Pree can see, and I didn't use `search_messages`.
